entries.reason: katex 0.16.47: via mermaid and @lobehub/ui (remark-math); the fix is only in 0.18.2+, which neither accepts.
The fix is only in minimatch 11. 10.2.5 comes in via eslint (lint-time, our own config globs) and Expo build tooling (mobile, our own project files); no untrusted glob patterns.
The crash needs an argument whose toString is not a function; only our own calls reach it.

Via Expo build tooling in the mobile app (@expo/cli dev server and code signing, @expo/config): runs on the developer machine at build and dev-server time on our own project files, never shipped in the app bundle. node-forge 1.4.1 (published 2026-10-27) and glob 14.0.2 (2026-10-27, a major bump from 13) clear the 14-day minimumReleaseAge on 2026-11-10; deepmerge has no fix. Re-check on the next Expo SDK bump.
